_comment: IFR-specific flight rules — merged with eu/vfr/flight_rules.json at load time. Object keys extend (never override) VFR entries; arrays are appended.

ifr_defaults._comment: Consumed by build_vars() via flight_phase::ifr_defaults(). initial_altitude_ft is the default climb clearance limit when no ATC-assigned level is available.
ifr_defaults._comment_tower_report: EUROCONTROL: Tower keeps the aircraft after takeoff, the takeoff clearance ends with 'report passing 3000 feet', and hands to Approach/Departure only once passing that height AGL -- then APP/DEP gives FL110. Set 0 for legacy immediate transfer (APP contact embedded in the takeoff clearance).

intent_preconditions._note_INITIAL_CALL_CENTER: The base (VFR) rule allows only CLIMB/CRUISE; merge_into APPENDS these phases -> CLIMB,CRUISE,PATTERN,FINAL_APPROACH. A sector/Center check-in is valid in ANY airborne phase -- the 'you appear to be on the ground' rejection must fire only on the ground. The geometric phase detector mislabels a low IFR climb-out as PATTERN/FINAL, which used to block the check-in with Milan (LIMF 2026-07-27).

REQUEST_STARTUP.rejection: {callsign}, contact Delivery or Ground for startup.

intent_frequency._note_READY_FOR_DEPARTURE: IFR override of VFR rejection wording. Real ICAO ATC does an immediate Tower handoff with freq when the pilot says 'ready for departure' on Ground (no conditional 'when ready'), because the pilot has already declared readiness. VFR file keeps the upstream 'contact Tower when ready for departure' wording for the VFR flow; merge_into deep-merges these keys so the IFR entries take precedence for IFR flights.

auto_corrections._comment_IFR/DEPARTURE_CLEARED: Departure frequency handoff is handled by poll_departure_handoff() in engine.cpp — no silent auto-correction needed here.

pilot_phraseology.REQUEST_IFR_CLEARANCE: {airport} Delivery, {callsign}{aircraft_type_phrase}, request IFR clearance to {ifr_destination}, information {atis_letter}
pilot_phraseology.READY_FOR_DEPARTURE_IFR: {airport} Tower, {callsign}, {holding_point}, ready for departure IFR to {ifr_destination}
